caption.linkedin:
Three reasons hybrid events go wrong, and how we remove each one.

1. Venue Wi-Fi drops mid-keynote. We bring bonded multi-carrier cellular internet and never depend on the venue network.
2. Remote speakers look like an afterthought. We integrate Zoom, Teams or Webex guests into the live switch with proper audio, lower-thirds and a moderator.
3. Nobody owns the run-of-show. One lead producer walks the venue with you, builds the timing sheet and stays from load-in to the last cue.

Executive Hybrid Suite from $4,450: 3-camera live stream, digital PA with 4 wireless mics, photo kiosk, photographer and 4K ISO recordings for meetings up to 120 guests.

Details: https://nexuslivemedia.com/services/hybrid-conferencing
